**User Story:**
As a buyer, I want to submit revisions and answer feasibility questions, so I can complete specifications.

**Epic:** E02 — Buyer procurement & RFQ  
**Domain:** Frontend / Backend  
**Type:** Feature  
**Priority:** P1  
**Target Release:** C — Controlled pilot — after operational gates  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 3 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Frontend/Backend  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** Expanded product scope; no PDF story mapping  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P1`, `release:C`, `epic:E02`, `frontend`, `backend`

**Dependencies:** [E02-04](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/96)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: —; additional proposed blockers: E02-04.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Changes create a version with traceable history.
- [ ] Link clarification questions and buyer answers to the request.
- [ ] Version revisions with author, date, reason and predecessor.
- [ ] Preserve earlier versions and flag affected quotes for review.
- [ ] Reject stale writes and route accepted-contract changes to amendments.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Use append-only RFQRevision and optimistic concurrency; E03-09 governs accepted obligations.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Revise quantity after quoting; verify old terms remain visible and cannot be accepted against changed scope.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.
